(Search snippet content — NPR reporting, w/c 22 July 2026)

The United States and Iran exchanged strikes aimed at infrastructure and military targets as their battle over the Strait of Hormuz intensified. US Central Command targeted Iranian military operations centres, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities and military logistics infrastructure, with attacks aimed at degrading Iran's control over the Strait of Hormuz. Iran fired at a commercial ship passing through the Strait and said it was closing the vital waterway completely.

Netanyahu (via his office, after a 9 July phone call with Trump): "The Iranian axis is weaker than ever before, while Israel is stronger than ever before."

(Corroborates the brief's Iran-war and Hormuz-tanker items: nightly CENTCOM strikes degrading Iranian control of the Strait, and Iran's interdiction of shipping.)
